projects.name: Texas wind farm
projects.quote: In February, we closed the acquisition of a 114 MW wind farm in Texas.

projects.name: Texas wind farm data center
projects.quote: We expect to build the data center for $150-250/kWh, approximately 60% less than a potential new site build.

projects.name: North Dakota and Texas gas-to-power operations
projects.quote: We fully energized our 25 MW gas-to-power operations across wellheads in North Dakota and Texas.

projects.name: Ohio data center 50 MW expansion
projects.quote: Lastly, we completed a 50 MW expansion at our fully owned data center in Ohio, bringing total operational capacity to 100 MW, ● with the site designed to scale up to 200 MW.

projects.name: 2PIC two-phase immersion cooling pilot
projects.quote: A 30 MW pilot is underway, and we remain on track to share market feedback on 2PIC’s performance and optimizing mining efficiency in the second half of the year.
